resources.string: A payment PIN screen was opened while on a call with an unknown number.
A bank, payment or email sign-in screen was opened while on a call with an unknown number.
A one-time code arrived while on a call with an unknown number. Scammers ask people to read these out.
A bank or payment app was opened while on a call with an unknown number.
An app that lets someone else control this phone is in use.
The screen-control app is being used during a call with an unknown number.
An app reported a new sign-in to one of this person\'s accounts.
The new sign-in happened during a call with an unknown number.
Money left an account in an amount much larger than usual for this person.
A call with an unknown, hidden or foreign number has lasted more than 15 minutes.
A bank or payment app reported a large amount leaving an account.
The call has gone on for more than 45 minutes. Fake \'arrest\' and \'police\' scams keep people on long calls.
The same unknown number has called three or more times in two hours.
The caller\'s number is hidden or from another country.
This happened between midnight and 5 a.m.
A chat app was opened right after a one-time code arrived. Scammers ask people to send them the code.
This happened during a call with an unknown number, which is how code-sharing scams work.
Screen sharing was started. Whoever is watching can see codes, PINs and passwords.
Screen sharing was started during a call with an unknown number.
A remote-control app was just installed. Scammers use these apps to take over phones.
An app was installed from outside the Play Store. Fake bank apps are spread this way.
The app was installed during a call with an unknown number.
An app was given permission to read and control the screen.
An app was made a device administrator, which lets it lock or erase the phone.
The permission was given during a call with an unknown number.
The wrong screen-lock PIN or pattern was entered 3 or more times. Someone else may be trying to get into the phone.
The wrong PIN was entered 5 or more times within a few minutes.
An app reported a failed sign-in or a wrong password or PIN.
Several failed sign-ins were reported in a short time.
Your guardian paused this phone for a few minutes to keep you safe.
